title: Friendly, informative, and well worth the money.
text: Ale was wonderful! From his initial greeting at the bus, asking everyone where they were from, how they enjoyed Montserrat, explaining what we could do during our free time, and his familiarity with local history, he was friendly, knowledgeable, and has a great smile. The guides on the bus we're also very good at helping us pass the time  pointing out wonderful views during the trip, telling jokes, and explaining history.

title: Beautiful day exploring Monserrat and enjoying local wine
text: We had an excellent day with our guide Vince exploring the beauty of Monserrat, while learning a lot of information about the history of Barcelona and the importance of the monks to Catalon language and culture. The tour was just the right amount of time for us to see this unique place before heading to a family owned winery- Oller el Mas in the afternoon with picturesque views and wines, as well as tapas.
